csv_project_name: PE & Plan for I-70 Pavement Patching
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana , Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide preliminary engineering and plan development services for I-70 Pavement Patching, The selected firm shall perform preliminary engineering and plan development services necessary to produce construction contract documents in accordance with the INDOT project development process. The selected firm shall complete Road Design and Construction Phase Services. Other services may also be provided if needed such as Archeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigation, professional public outreach and marketing services, and Wetland Mitigation. INDOT will provide the following if needed Geotechnical Engineering, Ecological Surveys, Environmental Documentation, Permits Applications, Pavement Design, Utility Coordination, and Real Estate Services. The INDOT Project Manager and the Consultant will schedule the Scoping Meeting within two (2) weeks of the Notice of Selection. The selected firm's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item. The contract may utilize the INDOT eInvoice application

title: Preliminary Engineering and Plan Development for I-70 Pavement Patching
short_description: Consulting services for preliminary engineering and road design for I-70 pavement patching.
project_scope: Preliminary engineering and plan development for pavement patching on Interstate 70. The consultant is to prepare construction contract documents under the INDOT project development process and provide road design and construction phase services. Additional possible tasks include archaeological investigations, historical/architectural investigation, public outreach and marketing services, and wetland mitigation. INDOT may separately provide geotechnical engineering, ecological surveys, environmental documentation, permit applications, pavement design, utility coordination, and real estate services.
services: Preliminary engineering, plan development, road design, and construction phase services; possible ancillary services include archaeology, historical/architectural investigation, public outreach, and wetland mitigation.
relevance_explanation:
- Highway pavement patching project, not a bridge or special structure.
- Scope is primarily road design for maintenance/rehabilitation rather than new structurally demanding construction.
- No indication of long spans, innovative structural systems, lightweight design, or architectural complexity.
- Includes civil engineering consulting, but the technical focus does not match sbp's core strengths.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: contract value stated as $5.4M.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated. Only overall contract value of 5.4 million USD is provided.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, planning/master planning, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
